author: NingMeng123
scope: R196 registered and called enchantment effects; enchanting offers/catalog are specified separately.
evidence_policy: An effect is enabled only where a registered enchantment is read by a reachable gameplay call; class names and language entries are not sufficient evidence.

equipment_level.formula: max of equipped levels, never sum
equipment_level.note: Player ae() is inventory armor array; Mob ae() is its complete legacy equipment array. Legal per-item applicability normally limits slot.

registration.note: All effects below are instantiated in the unconditional aau static initializer and included in c; each has concrete gameplay reads recorded below.

biological_target.formula: default !isUndead; golems, magma cubes, endermen, earth/fire elementals and hellhounds override false
biological_target.note: Do not approximate this solely as !UNDEAD; ordinary slimes/gelatinous cubes lack an override and remain biologically alive under this source predicate.

effects.trigger: Recoverable player arrow embeds in LivingEntity and resolves its contained-item return.
effects.formula: nextInt(5) < L => recover; otherwise independent nextFloat() < material_probability. Total P = L/5 + (1-L/5)*p.
inputs: current shooter main-hand enchantment at collision
outputs: one arrow enters target contained-items on recovery; dies with target inventory drops
effects.server: Roll and persist contained arrow once, including fatal impact.
effects.client: Use synchronized arrow visuals; no client reward roll.
effects.current_integration: ranged/ArrowRecovery.java already owns fatal/drop atomicity; add enchantment chance there rather than an independent second drop listener.

effects.trigger: Player or mob melee attack returned negatively affected LivingEntity.
effects.formula: P=L/10; apply Slowness(duration=50*L ticks, amplifier=5*L). Amplifier is zero-based and intentionally high.
effects.server: Resolve proc after native successful hit, including mob melee.
effects.client: Render normal synchronized effect and movement prediction.
effects.current_integration: Use melee-only context around Player.attack/Mob.doHurtTarget; do not proc on arrows or generic fire damage.
effects.negative_result: Negative includes health loss, destruction, knockback and held/armor durability loss. Modern bool false with observed armor wear still qualifies.

effects.trigger: Each source fishing bite attempt after water geometry/line-of-reach checks.
effects.formula: N=blueMoon?600:clamp(int(600*min(abs(T-5500),abs(T-17500))/600),600,2400); rain halves N; enabled-skill without FISHING doubles N; repeat L times N=floor(N*9/10); hotbar raw worm halves N; bite iff nextInt(N)==0.
outputs: bite probability denominator reduced, not extra items or rarity
effects.server: Own random bite eligibility and hook state.
effects.current_integration: FoodFishingBaitMixin currently maps captured modern luck onto this factor; read new MITE enchantment level independently and preserve modern Luck of the Sea loot luck.
gaps: Skills branch must remain gated by actual world skills setting; default modern port has no skill system and should not silently penalize all players.

effects.trigger: Successful survival harvest of legacy log block, outside existing felling recursion.
effects.formula: For dy=1..L, while same x,z above is a log, perform full ordinary player break; stop at first non-log.
outputs: up to L additional log breaks, each native wear/drops/checks
effects.server: Perform normal break path under recursion guard and protection checks.
effects.client: Receive normal block updates, no predicted extra harvest.

acceptance.case: level III with five stacked logs

effects.current_integration: Extend log identity to modern logs tag; record this modern mapping explicitly. Never fell entire connected tree or bypass the native server player break path.

effects.trigger: Successful melee against biologically alive LivingEntity with positive passed damage.
effects.formula: P=L/10; transfer=max(1,int((damage*0.5F)*U)); second U is independent uniform [0,1).

damage_basis.player: raw melee damage variable passed before target defenses (uf.java:1116)
damage_basis.mob: EntityDamageResult actual amount of health lost (tm.java:84,138)

effects.secondary_effect: Scythe base attack decay rate is 1 when Vampiric is present, else 2 when Sharpness is present, else 4.
outputs: integer attacker heal, native cap and heal particles
effects.server: Roll once after successful hit; heal attacker and source-compatible particles.
effects.current_integration: SourceEnchantmentCombat implements different player raw vs mob actual-health-loss bases. EquipmentDurability must prioritize Vampiric over Sharpness for scythe decay.

effects.server: Keep movement allowance and tracked attributes consistent.
effects.client: Apply equivalent prediction from synchronized armor.

acceptance.case: same enchant illegally on multiple pieces

effects.current_integration: Player-only attribute modifier refreshed on equipment change; source call site is PlayerAbilities, not a generic mob-speed effect.

effects.formula: increment=(0.0004F + nutrition*0.00002F)*(malnourished?0.25:1)*(inBed?4:1)*(1+0.5*max_equipped_L). At progress>=1 and naturalRegeneration && damaged, heal1, add hunger1, subtract1.
effects.server: Advance existing heal progress and food costs.
effects.client: Display synchronized health and food; no independent tick heal.
effects.current_integration: FoodDataMixin currently passes0 to NutritionRules.regenerationIncrement; supply equipped level. Do not multiply potion/heal-command/Vampiric heals.

effects.formula: R=max_equipped_L*(0.8/4)=0.2L. Player aggregate slow=−0.2*(slowAmp+1)−(inWeb?0.75:0), haste=+0.2*(speedAmp+1); if sum<0 multiply sum by1−R; movementFactor=clamp(1+sum,0,4). Mob Slowness attribute amount multiplies1−R.
outputs: up to80% reduction in negative movement modifier
effects.server: Use the same speed factor when validating movement.
effects.client: Prediction must match server, including web movement.
effects.current_integration: SourceEnchantmentCombat refreshes potion attributes and a common Entity move hook retains native physical web friction plus source movement factor for enchanted players. With no Free Action, existing modern potion/web behavior is preserved.
effects.physical_web_friction: nn:747-754 additionally multiplies actual movement by .25/.05/.25 and zeroes velocity; Free Action reduces the separate negative movement-factor amount, not this physical friction.

effects.trigger: Bow pull calculation (normal and reinforced source bows).
outputs: faster full draw and corresponding full-pull critical state
effects.server: Use revised pull for actual projectile speed/critical and minimum shot threshold.
effects.client: Use same revised pull for pull model stages/FOV.
effects.current_integration: Must cover BowItem.releaseUsing and getPowerForTime-derived predicates; a client-only model speedup is insufficient.

effects.formula: E=effectivePlayerLevel+round(40*L/5); wander=E<0?5−0.5E:0.5+4.5/(0.8+(E+1)/5)^2; multiply2 if shooter suspended in liquid.
outputs: Gaussian launch spread reduced via virtual XP level; does not alter gravity or speed
effects.current_integration: SourceBowLaunch already owns exact Gaussian launch; add equivalent levels before R196WeaponRules.inaccuracy.

effects.trigger: Bow arrow successfully negatively affected LivingEntity.
effects.formula: P=L/5; apply Poison I for160+round(240*L/5) ticks.
inputs: shooter's current main-hand launcher at impact (legacy getLauncher)
outputs: Poison effect subject to biological immunity and existing potion handling
effects.server: Roll after successful arrow hit; no melee or failed-hit application.
effects.current_integration: Modern native projectile weapon snapshot can supply launcher state safely across equipment changes; if adopted, document this explicit modern persistence adaptation.

effects.trigger: Player melee attack with positive raw damage before target's hurt call; target must be legacy Mob with nonempty held item.
effects.formula: P=L/5; drop original held ItemStack, clear its matching equipment slot; ticks_disarmed=40.
outputs: one actual held stack on ground
effects.server: Only server executes drop/slot removal and pickup cooldown; persist cooldown.

acceptance.result: disarm may already have happened, by source ordering

effects.current_integration: Do not add post-damage only event or allow disarming players. Native pickup checks require a dedicated transient/persisted timer.

effects.trigger: Nonabsolute incoming source damage passes target armor defense calculation.
effects.formula: piercing=(L/5)*5=L; effectiveProtection=max(totalProtection−piercing,0). Armor wear is computed using unpierced original armor protection before this subtraction.
outputs: less absorbed damage; no added raw damage against unarmored target
effects.current_integration: Current port uses modern percent-based armor reduction for most combat; port source point-defense pipeline or explicitly record a modern equivalent, never pretend modern crossbow Piercing is identical.

effects.trigger: Source-compatible animal/arachnid death drop routine queries responsible LivingEntity held-item level.

formula_by_entity.cow: well => nextInt(3)+1+nextInt(1+L); if total1 then50% chance add1

outputs: additional meat; higher spider-eye chance; no blanket leather/wool multiplication
effects.server: Integrate within existing source drop routine to avoid duplicate drops.
effects.current_integration: SourceVanillaMobLoot already reads mite:butchering and uses these formulas. Add missing enchantment registration, not a second extra-drop modifier; confirm R196 new arachnids delegate this same helper.

effects.server: Scale only identified action charges, not global FoodData.addExhaustion.
effects.client: Mining prediction charge must remain consistent where prediction exists.
effects.current_integration: Existing mining uses source-like wear/speed but not all original action hunger charges. Hook existing action endpoints and mark any deferred cost-source coverage explicitly.

existing_agriculture.status: Already registered by AgriculturalEnchantments and applied in crop code; retain source mechanics and do not multiply them again.
existing_agriculture.spec_reference: Existing crop mechanics specifications and AgriculturalEnchantments.java

vanilla_effect_differences.formula: L flat damage; Smite and Bane each2L only matching target, and all three mutually exclusive
vanilla_effect_differences.current: Generated native effect is source L; target-family Smite and Bane are2L; no modern Bane extra slow.

vanilla_effect_differences.formula: effective held tool strength += L²+1 before survival/level multipliers; ineffective tool returns to empty-hand calculation without bonus
vanilla_effect_differences.current: Modern native formula matches core additive arithmetic; preserve effective-tool gate.

vanilla_effect_differences.formula: max5; per durability point negate with probability0.75*(L/5), including solid-metal armor
vanilla_effect_differences.current: DurabilityEnchantmentMixin and EquipmentDurabilityRules already implement source probability for managed gear.

vanilla_effect_differences.formula: General protection raises individual armor protection multiplier by1+0.5*(L/4); separate fire/blast/projectile protection adds each armor's damage-scaled source protection*(L/4). Feather Falling grants15*(L/4)*armorDamageFactor, not modern EPF percent.
vanilla_effect_differences.current: Existing SourceArmorDefense/MobCombat apply flat defense; native defense effects are not applied again after source processing.
Native1.21Power effect shape is compatible; avoid double-adding on source arrows.

vanilla_effect_differences.formula: Arrow ignition requests100seconds: nn.d multiplies by20 and adds10 =>2010ticks. Flaming arrow ignites a living victim for5seconds+10 =>110ticks.
vanilla_effect_differences.current: Generated projectile_spawned duration100.5seconds; source bow impact requests5.5seconds. Native fire protection applies once.

vanilla_effect_differences.formula: No Infinity enchantment is registered at51;51 is Arrow Recovery and survival bow always consumes an arrow.
vanilla_effect_differences.current: Modern-only Infinity retained under overall port policy unless separate user balance decision; must not call it an R196 enchantment.

vanilla_effect_differences.formula: highest equipped level determines proc P=0.15L; on proc damage=L>10?L-10:1+nextInt(4). First equipped matching stack takes3durability on proc,1on failed proc, through normalUnbreaking/lastpoint protection.
vanilla_effect_differences.item_selection: NOT random. aaw.a(enchantment,entity) returns first matched stack in ae() iteration: Player boots,legs,chest,head; Mob held then those armor slots.
vanilla_effect_differences.proc_random_source: Attacking player or mob RNG for melee; projectile RNG for arrow collisions. Reflect uses source thorns/magic-aspect damage and does not recurse through melee hooks.
vanilla_effect_differences.enabled_trigger: Original player/mob melee negatively affected target; successful damaging arrow hit likewise calls abh with shooter. Do not trigger on generic poison/fire/fall damage.

acceptance.case: armor wear but zero health loss

vanilla_effect_differences.server: Own reflection roll, reflecteddamage and itemwear; normal native postattack thorns effect must be cleared to avoid doubling.
vanilla_effect_differences.client: Use normal damage and equipment synchronization.

vanilla_effect_differences.formula: Successful source melee sets4L seconds plus10ticks; I90 and II170ticks.
vanilla_effect_differences.current: Generated post_attack ignite duration base4.5, per_level4; native primary melee path verified.

evidence_gaps.detail: Mending, Frost Walker, curses, modern crossbow/trident/mace enchantments have noR196 counterpart. Preserve modern content per project policy and record balancing separately.
Legacy arrow getLauncher reads current held stack at impact. Modern projectile native persisted weapon snapshot avoids equipment-swap changes. Whichever behavior chosen must be disclosed and tested.
Archery/fishing skill penalties in source depend on world.areSkillsEnabled; do not infer enabled merely from Skill enum.
